summary: NextSync 0.2.6: white tray glyphs and a remote-folder picker that lists existing server folders (blank field auto-names after the local folder).
changelog: The tray icon glyphs now use a fixed white stroke, so the host renders the exact Lucide cloud/cloud-off design in white on the panel instead of black or a wrong color.
The Add Folder dialog now lists the remote folders that already exist on the server (WebDAV PROPFIND), so you can pick one instead of typing a path.
Leaving the remote folder field blank now creates a remote folder with the same name as the local folder (e.g. /home/user/NextCloud -> /NextCloud) instead of mapping to the account root.
